name: Thorna Grabbler
description: The head of Steamflogger Industries who recruited the goblins and formed the Goblin Explosioneers.

timeline.summary: Ming-na tells of Steamflogger Industries, a steel mill, and its recruitment of goblins.
timeline.quote: It all started years ago with Steamflogger Industries.

timeline.summary: Thorna Grabbler lures a goblin clan to work in the factory with hammers and technology (flashback).
timeline.quote: The entire clan of goblins chose to come work in the factory.

timeline.summary: Thorna forms the Goblin Explosioneers as a political faction.
timeline.quote: She let the goblins choose the name and ended up with the Goblin Explosioneers.

timeline.summary: The goblins take over Steamflogger Industries as workers, management and finally Thorna leave.
timeline.quote: The goblins had taken over Steamflogger Industries.

relations.note: She formed the faction from the goblin workers.
relations.quote: She let the goblins choose the name and ended up with the Goblin Explosioneers.

pages_say.description: The head of Steamflogger Industries who recruited the goblins and formed the Goblin Explosioneers.
